title: Adaptive Kernel Ridge Regression with Linear Structure: Sharp Oracle Inequalities and Minimax Optimality
summary: Kernel ridge regression (KRR) is a widely used nonparametric method due to its strong theoretical guarantees and computational convenience. However, standard KRR does not distinguish between linear and nonlinear components in the signal, instead applying a single functional regularization to the entire function. This may lead to unnecessary shrinkage of linear structure and consequently suboptimal prediction performance.
